description: This file defines an abstract class 'Plugins_DeliveryLimitations' for delivery limitation plugins in the Revive Adserver project. It includes class properties, constructor, initialization, resource loading, and various methods related to delivery limitations, including UI rendering and data handling.

classes.name: Plugins_DeliveryLimitations
classes.description: An abstract class for delivery limitation plugins, providing properties and methods for plugin initialization, resource loading, UI rendering, and data management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, particularly the list of available operations.

methods.name: Plugins_DeliveryLimitations
methods.description: Placeholder for old PHP4 constructor to prevent upgrade issues.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with provided data, sets display name, and loads resources.

methods.name: _getRes
methods.description: Loads localized resources for the plugin from a PHP include file.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the localized name of the plugin based on the 'nameEnglish' property.

methods.name: isAllowed
methods.description: Checks if the plugin is allowed for use; defaults to true.

methods.name: checkInputData
methods.description: Validates input data; currently always returns true.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Outputs HTML for the plugin's UI representation, including controls for logical operators, display name, and data.

methods.name: displayComparison
methods.description: Outputs HTML select element for choosing comparison operators.

methods.name: displayData
methods.description: Outputs HTML input for plugin data.

methods.name: _flattenData
methods.description: Converts data into a string format suitable for database storage.

methods.name: _expandData
methods.description: Converts stored string data back into expanded form.

methods.name: _preCompile
methods.description: Prepares data for compilation, possibly transforming it.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates a string representing the compiled limitation.

methods.name: compileData
methods.description: Generates a string for arbitrary data to be used in evaluation.

methods.name: getMpeClassInstance
methods.description: Returns an instance for MPE use, defaulting to an empty delivery limitation.
